title: Formation of blastoids from mouse embryonic and trophoblast stem cells
protocol: Form PDMS stamps through replica molding using microstructured silicon wafers processed via deep reactive ion etching.
Use the PDMS stamps to imprint hydrogel microwell arrays in 6 well-plates and then cut and insert into 12-well plates.
Alternatively, directly imprint microwell arrays into 96-well plates.
Maintain ESCs on a gelatin coating in medium #1 (2i medium) for 11 days.
Prepare a bank of 50 vials, each containing 0.5 million cells.
Defrost a vial when starting a blastoid experiment and plate the cells on gelatin in medium #1.
Culture the cells for two days after plating.
Passage the cells and seed at 15,000 cells/cm².
Continue culturing the cells for another two days.
Cultivate ESCs for a total of 15 days in medium #1 before starting the blastoid experiment.
Defrost a 10 ml bottle of Matrigel® by standing overnight in a fridge.
Aliquot Matrigel® into 1 ml Eppendorf tubes, keeping both the tubes and pipet tips cooled in a freezer.
Resuspend one tube of defrosted Matrigel® at 1/90 v/v in ice-cold DMEM/F12.
Add the suspension to a cell culture dish (1 ml per 10 cm²) and incubate for one hour inside a laminar flow hood, at room temperature.
Remove the Matrigel® suspension from the dish before seeding TSCs in medium #3.
Maintain TSCs previously cultured with serum in medium #3 for three weeks before banking them.
Prepare a bank of 50 vials containing 0.5 million cells per vial.
Defrost one vial when starting a blastoid experiment and plate it on Matrigel® in medium #3.
Culture the cells for two days, then passage and seed at 15,000 cells/cm².
Culture the TSCs for four more days under these conditions.
Wash ESCs with PBS.
Trypsinize ESCs for three minutes to form a single cell suspension.
Inhibit trypsin using soya bean solution.
Suspend cells in medium #2 (serum medium).
Count cell concentration using a counting chamber.
Seed cells on top of microwell arrays at a concentration resulting in five cells per microwell.
Use 1 ml of medium #2 for ESC aggregation.
Form tight, round aggregates within 24-36 hours.
Wash TSCs with PBS after 24-36 hours.
Trypsinize TSCs for three minutes to form a single cell suspension.
Inhibit trypsin using soya bean solution.
Suspend cells in medium #4 (blastoid medium).
Count cell concentration using a counting chamber.
Remove most of the medium #2 from microwell arrays.
Seed TSCs on top of microwell arrays containing ESC aggregates at a concentration resulting in 12 cells per microwell.
Wait for cells to settle within microwells for 15 minutes.
Add 1 ml of medium #4.
Seed TSCs as the starting point \(0 hours) for cell culture synchronization.
Aggregate TSCs with ESCs within 24 hours.
Add 1 mM 8Br-cAMP in 10 μl of F12 medium to each microwell array at 24 hours.
Monitor aggregation and formation of blastoids within 48 hours.
Harvest formed blastoids using a mouth pipet holding a glass capillary under a stereomicroscope.
Prepare dissociation capillaries of different sizes (75-150 μm).
Warm up the incubator/shaker to 37°C and set up at ~350RPM.
Warm up the hotplate.
Defreeze and warm up the Collagenase IV, TrypleE, RNA-free BSA, and maintain them in the water-bath.
Prepare 15 ml of PBS + 2% FBS (PBS+).
Prepare 1 ml of PBS + 1 μL of Hoechst.
Add 150 μl PBS in two rows of the 96 well plate; 50 μl of collagenase IV 600U/ml in a third row; and 100 μl of RNA-free BSA in a fourth row.
Take 150 blastoids / EBs / Trophospheres out of the microwells and wash them with 2x PBS-0 (without Ca/Mg).
Deposit blastoids / EBs / Trophospheres in 50 μl of Collagenase IV 600U/ml.
Tape the plate at the bottom of a plastic box and place the box in the bacteria shaker, at 350RPM for 30 minutes.
Trypsinize ESC and TSC from the 6 well-plate 2D culture during the blastoids dissociation process.
Block with the trypsin inhibitor.
Spin down and re-suspend the cells in 3 ml of PBS+.
Add 1 ml to each FACS tube.
Place the tubes on ice while waiting for FACS.
Transfer blastocysts to TrypleE 10X undiluted.
Shake for 20 minutes.
Bring to the stereomicroscope.
Use a large capillary to dissociate the cluster into single cells.
Prepare an Eppendorf with 200 μL of trypsin inhibitor.
Harvest cells using a P200 and place in the Eppendorf.
Wash each well three times with PBS+ and add wash solution to the Eppendorf.
Harvest again using a P1000 and push through the filter of a FACS tube.
Add 30 μL of pre-diluted Hoechst (1/400).
Place on ice for FACS analysis as soon as possible.
